# 1000 - Hello World!

**Category:** Beginner

## Description

Welcome to beecrowd!

Your first program in any programming language is usually "Hello World!". In this problem, all you have to do is print this message.

## Input

This problem has no input.

## Output

Print `Hello World!` with a newline at the end.

## Example

| Input | Output |
|-------|--------|
| (none) | Hello World! |

## RPython Features Used

- `print_line()` builtin for output
